design_decisions: The poller lives in the definePlugin lifetime and reads update context on every tick, so it remains active while the QAM panel is closed and observes setting changes without a store subscription.
All RPC, toast, logging, and timer effects are dependency-injected; start and dispose are exposed on a frozen runtime object.
Every background check passes force=false, leaving the backend's 24-hour GitHub-fetch cache authoritative.
The poller dispatches the toast before persisting last_notified_tag and checks disposal after each awaited boundary, so a dismounted instance cannot emit a late toast or mark a tag it did not notify.

The QAM controller's automatic-check effect reads the latest callback from a ref while depending only on updateChannel, currentVersion, and isHydrated; check-result and hydration state transitions no longer retrigger a forced automatic check.

The pre-existing frontend audit gate began failing on newly published postcss and brace-expansion advisories. PostCSS was pinned to 8.5.18 with a version-specific minimum-age exception. The brace-expansion v5 fix is API-incompatible with the pinned minimatch build toolchain, so GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg is narrowly ignored for repository-owned build-time glob patterns after an attempted v5 override failed the Rollup packaging tests.
The unrelated untracked SDH-Ludusavi Installer Bundle.zip was preserved and excluded from all commits.
